periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique vertical orientation, with the primary axis of the patches angled roughly 70-80 degrees relative to the horizontal facial midline, tapering inward toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; the vertical length of the black patch is approximately twice its horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering where the bottom of the patch extends further from the ocular center than the top, creating a teardrop-style vertical descent.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, with the ears positioned at the far distal margins of the white cranial fur region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly convex and rounded, showing a semi-circular arc with no visible notches or flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-tan staining/discoloration present across the ventral white fur of the abdominal and thoracic regions.
